classification: Mallory old-agent frame-resolution recursion, not a demonstrated Hadoop test classloader or workload failure
causal_assessment: The old MalloryTransformer$SafeWriter has a java.lang.Class.forName(name,false,loader) method reference. Its frame hierarchy resolution runs while DataNode is being defined. Recursive loading of the same DataNode name in AppClassLoader explains the duplicate-definition LinkageError. The fixed SafeWriter reads .class resources without defining the class. The archived HDFS-48 old-agent failure and fixed-agent success with the same HDFS adapter are an independent A/B check. The archived stack does not record an inner transformer stack, so the exact recursive invocation is inferred, not directly observed.

not_double_retransform_evidence.archive_site_catalog_detail: Each failed trial has exactly three DataNode site rows from one original/transformed class-hash pair and one AppClassLoader identity; no evidence of repeated DataNode transform in the catalog.
